text:
nate: Heads-up — planning a soft-unpin rollout for runtime-2.15 in eu-west tonight at 23:30 UTC. Keeping a small pinlist for known sticky combos, posting proposed exceptions below.

amanda: Do we have a concise list of pinned models/SDKs to preserve? Want to avoid any surprises for Dedicated customers.

deploybot: [deploybot] pinlist change proposed by nate. Preview: ```diff
--- pinlist/runtime.yaml (v2.14)
+++ pinlist/runtime.yaml (v2.15)
@@
-  - model: gpt3a-legacy
-    reason: longseq kv-cache incompat
+  # removed gpt3a-legacy — compatibility validated in staging
+  - model: llama3q-quant
+    reason: keep-for-eu-dedicated
```

sophie: For rollback/abort criteria — suggest: latency p50 increase >10% sustained for 10m OR error-rate spike >3% for 5m. Also automatic fallback to runtime-2.14 if canary fails. Thoughts?

eric: Do we have longseq perf telemetry for llama3q in eu-west canary? Need baseline numbers to compare. If not, add 1h pre-run warmup and capture.

lina: I’ll add a canary cohort: 1% traffic for 30m, then 5% for 60m if stable. Also adding smoke tests in release notes: embeddings, chat-sanity, and 4k token longseq.

sre-oncall: Acknowledge. I’ll watch infra dashboards and keep pager rotation aware. If we hit rollback thresholds I’ll trigger the manual rollback runbook.

nate: Rollback commands (if needed):
```bash
# force rollback to pinned runtime
deploybot rollback --env eu-west --runtime 2.14 --reason "post-unpin regression"
# quick pin reapply
deploybot pin add --env eu-west --model gpt3a-legacy --note "re-pin on regression"
```

amanda: Add SDK compatibility gate in the checklist — SDK v3.5 needs a quick smoke against runtime-2.15 before we lift global pin. Can someone own that? @eric?

eric: I’ll run the SDK smoke suite at 22:45 UTC and post results here. Will include tokenization and sample chat traces.

deploybot: [deploybot] pinlist staged. Please react with :thumbsup: to approve change or :x: to request hold. Changes will be applied at 23:30 UTC if >=2 approvals.

sophie: Adding automated alerts: create anomaly alert for p50 and 95th, and a regression eval that runs on the canary prompt set.

nate: Approved. I’ll start the rollout at 23:30. If anyone sees oddness, ping this thread and tag sre-oncall and deploybot. Thanks — short window tonight, we’ll revert quickly if any of the thresholds trip.
